_note: Every enabled Mayhem augment on the patch. Ids, names, rarities and values are the client files (kiwi.bin, each augment's spell DataValues and calculations), filled in by tools/build_augments.py through MAPPING there and tools/augment_effects.py. An augment with no stats or effects has no effect in the simulator (its note says why). confidence is verified when every value is read from the client and approx when one rests on an assumption the note states. Effect keys: README.md.
